d: Cyclone Arnab has brought heavy rainfall and strong winds to coastal Andhra Pradesh, damaging homes, uprooting trees and flooding roads. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) warned of intense winds and heavy rain as the cyclone made landfall. More than 1.8 lakh people were evacuated to safer locations across Andhra Pradesh and Odisha. But how does a cyclone form over the sea? Why do its winds rotate, and where does it get the energy to cause widespread destruction? In this explainer, we break down the science behind cyclones, the Coriolis effect, low-pressure areas, storm surges and…
